findings.issue: `wave: final` is a string, but the task template specifies wave as a number >= 1. Pure schema-strict reading would flag this as a type violation.
findings.fix: Either (a) keep the project convention of `wave: final` for the post-deploy/QA final wave (already used by Task 9 and Task 10 in this feature, so it is a documented project convention) and accept the deviation; or (b) replace with a numeric value (e.g. `wave: 5`) consistent with the wave numbering of preceding tasks. No action required if the orchestrator handles `final` as a magic value.

findings.issue: Task 11 declares `depends_on: [10]` but both Task 10 and Task 11 share `wave: final`. The validator rule `depends_on[X] => wave > wave_of(X)` cannot be satisfied with equal wave values; with string-typed wave it is also undecidable.
findings.fix: Acceptable as a convention (sequential ordering inside the Final Wave is implied by `depends_on`, and the orchestrator is expected to respect it). If the orchestrator does not honor depends_on within a wave, split Task 11 into a distinct trailing wave (e.g. `wave: post-deploy` or numeric).

findings.issue: Reviewers section content `(none — verification-таска, ревьюеры не назначены)` is a free-form annotation, not the template's bullet-list format. Acceptable because frontmatter `reviewers: []` is empty and the task is self-verifying QA — checklist permits empty reviewers for QA/deploy tasks. Keeping consistency with Task 9/10 of this feature.
findings.fix: No fix needed if convention. Optionally: render as `- none (self-verifying QA task)` to match bullet-list style of the template.

findings.issue: Section contains only `### User` subsection — no `### Automated` and no `### Smoke`. For a non-code post-deploy QA task this is appropriate (no test commands to run, no pre-deploy smoke applicable — verification IS the deploy gate). The verification logic itself lives in `What to do` Шаги 1-4.
findings.fix: No fix needed — appropriate for verification-only task. The `User` subsection correctly captures the operator-confirmation gate.
